tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search every document Vooks publishes for agents: the agent index, the pricing page, the site overview and the Public Catalog API guide. Returns the matching documents with an excerpt around the match, so you can quote Vooks rather than paraphrasing from memory. Use fetch_doc when an excerpt is not

tools.name: fetch_doc
tools.description: Fetch one published Vooks document whole, by the URI search_docs returned. Only documents Vooks publishes for agents resolve: this is an allowlist, not a general fetch tool, so it cannot be pointed at an arbitrary URL. Use it when you need the complete text rather than an excerpt.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List every document this server can read, with a one-line summary of each. Call it first if you would rather choose a document than search across all of them.
